name: ENKI Canonical Names & Sanctions Pack
description: Canonical alias and sanctions registry. Defines name normalization (Bibi -> Benjamin Netanyahu) and sanctions metadata (OFAC/EU/UK/UN list membership). Promoted from core/gdu/canonical_names.py in Phase 2.1 of the collapse rebuild plan so that knowledge of canonical identities is versioned, signed, and lineage-stamped on every entity that consults it.
